entries.13d85b8baf936c9a: The company has adopted the mission 'Look at today's retail distribution, design tomorrow,' and, with SPX (transformation through the sophistication and efficiency of sales promotion) at its core, states that it provides consistent collaborative support from the design of marketing strategies in the sales promotion field through planning, production, execution and effect verification. Its medium-term management plan 'SPX2027' had set numerical targets, but in light of factors such as heightened uncertainty in the business environment, the company withdrew the targets and states that, going forward, it will seek to enhance medium- to long-term corporate value by accumulating the achievement of priority strategies and performance targets set for each fiscal year.
entries.19c0710ef20e2b6a: Founded in 1956 in Nerima Ward, Tokyo, the company had 305 employees as of March 31, 2026. It has printing plants in Saitama and Wakayama.
entries.1c97464258969188: It provides sales promotion planning and production, sales promotion management systems, digital initiatives on WEB and SNS, and general printing on an integrated basis.
